integrity: The local rule and basic reversibility are prior art. Only the stated cyclic even/odd similarity classification, complete temporal fixed-point census and primitive-period relation are proposed as a new contribution. No external independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Characteristic-two finite fields, cyclic labelled rings with length at least three, and the specified linear second-order local rule only.
The general lattice-gas equivalence article of Toffoli, Capobianco and Mentrasti (2004) was accessible only as abstract; a hidden exact specialization remains a historical-priority risk.
Finite computational checks support but do not replace the all-length algebraic proof.
title: Parity-split orbit census for reversible nearest-neighbor waves on binary rings
